description: Edit a block's SOURCE content (Slate JSON). Note: edits live on the block, not in the stored source file — a later document_resync_source re-parses the file and overwrites them.

block_id.description: Block id (blocks[].id in document_content_get, format json).

block_type.description: Block type, e.g. paragraph, heading_1, bulleted_list; omit to keep the current one.

original_content.description: The new source content as Slate JSON: an array of element nodes, e.g. [{"type":"paragraph","children":[{"text":"Hello"}]}]. Read the current value with document_content_get (format json).

name: block_update
title: Edit block source
